title: phase 3: accounts, sessions, auth API, get_player in auth mode
test_cmd: uv run pytest tests/services/test_accounts.py tests/api/test_api_auth.py tests/api/test_api_phase0.py tests/api/test_api_phase1.py -q
criteria:
Phase 3 part 1: login accounts. Already present: tables/models Account(id, username, password_hash, is_admin, created_at), AuthSession(token_hash, account_id, created_at, expires_at), Player.account_id (nullable FK), settings `settings.auth_required` (default False), `settings.session_ttl_hours`. EDITING RULE: errors.py, deps.py, main.py, schemas.py already exist with proofread Thai: change them ONLY with small targeted Edit operations (never rewrite whole files). New logic goes into the NEW files accounts.py and routes/auth.py.
== realm/services/errors.py == add constants UNAUTHENTICATED = 'UNAUTHENTICATED', NO_PLAYER = 'NO_PLAYER', RATE_LIMITED = 'RATE_LIMITED', PAUSE_DISABLED = 'PAUSE_DISABLED' (same style as the others).
== realm/api/main.py == extend the error->HTTP status map: UNAUTHENTICATED -> 401, NO_PLAYER -> 404, RATE_LIMITED -> 429; include the new auth router with prefix '/api'.
== realm/services/accounts.py (new) ==
`hash_password(password: str) -> str` using hashlib.scrypt (n=2**14, r=8, p=1, dklen=32) with a random 16-byte salt, stored as 'scrypt$<salt hex>$<hash hex>'; `verify_password(password, stored) -> bool` (constant time via hmac.compare_digest); `register(s, username, password, now) -> Account`: username must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,20}$ else GameError INVALID_TARGET 'ชื่อผู้ใช้ไม่ถูกต้อง'; password length < 8 -> INVALID_TARGET 'รหัสผ่านสั้นเกินไป'; duplicate username (case-insensitive compare on lower()) -> INVALID_TARGET 'ชื่อผู้ใช้นี้ถูกใช้แล้ว'; the FIRST account in the table gets is_admin True; `login(s, username, password, now, ttl_hours) -> tuple[str, Account]`: unknown user or wrong password -> GameError UNAUTHENTICATED 'ชื่อผู้ใช้หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง' (same message for both); creates an AuthSession with token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) (return the raw token, store only sha256 hexdigest), expires_at = now + ttl; `logout(s, token) -> None` deletes that session (unknown token = no-op); `account_for_token(s, token, now) -> Account | None` (None for unknown or expired tokens; an expired row is deleted).
== realm/api/routes/auth.py (new) ==
COOKIE = 'rov_session'. POST /auth/register body {username, password} -> registers, logs in, sets the cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path='/', max_age = ttl seconds) and returns {'id','username','is_admin'}; POST /auth/login same body -> cookie + the same JSON; POST /auth/logout -> deletes the session and the cookie, returns {'ok': True}; GET /auth/me -> {'auth_required': settings.auth_required, 'account': {id, username, is_admin} | None, 'player': {id, name, tribe} | None} where the player is the account's player in the newest world (None when there is none or no world). Use realm.settings.settings (module-level instance; tests toggle it with monkeypatch) and the session dependency get_session; the current time comes from datetime.now(timezone.utc) inside the route (API layer is allowed to).
== realm/api/deps.py == add `get_account(request, s=Depends(get_session)) -> Account | None` reading the cookie via accounts.account_for_token. Change `get_player(s, world)` so that: when settings.auth_required is False the behaviour is EXACTLY as today (the single human of the world); when True: account = get_account; None -> GameError UNAUTHENTICATED 'กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบ'; the player = the Player with account_id == account.id in that world; none -> GameError NO_PLAYER 'ยังไม่ได้เข้าร่วมโลกนี้'. Read settings at call time (`from realm.settings import settings` and use settings.auth_required inside the function).
== Tests == tests/services/test_accounts.py (DB fixtures `s`, `t0`): hash/verify round trip (different salts give different hashes, wrong password fails, malformed stored value returns False); register ok; first account is admin, second is not; duplicate (also with different case) rejected; invalid usernames ('ab', 'a b', 21 chars, 'ก') -> INVALID_TARGET; short password (7 chars) rejected; login returns a token and the session row stores only the sha256 of it (the raw token is not in the table); wrong password and unknown user give the SAME GameError message; account_for_token returns the account before expiry and None after (t0 + ttl hours + 1 s) and deletes the expired row; logout invalidates the token. tests/api/test_api_auth.py (TestClient(create_app(serve_static=False)) with dependency_overrides[get_session] yielding the rollback `s` fixture; monkeypatch.setattr(settings, 'auth_required', True)): register -> 200, Set-Cookie 'rov_session' present and HttpOnly; GET /api/auth/me with the cookie -> account set, player None; without cookie -> account None; login with a wrong password -> 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; logout then /me -> account None; with auth_required True and no cookie GET /api/state -> 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; logged-in account without a player -> GET /api/state -> 404 NO_PLAYER; an account with a Player(account_id) in the world (create the world through worlds.create_world directly and set player.account_id on the human player) -> GET /api/state -> 200 with that player; another account (second register) -> 404 NO_PLAYER for the same world; with auth_required False (default) every existing endpoint works without any cookie (the phase 0/1 tests keep passing).
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY these exact strings (copy letter by letter; proofread): 'ชื่อผู้ใช้ไม่ถูกต้อง', 'รหัสผ่านสั้นเกินไป', 'ชื่อผู้ใช้นี้ถูกใช้แล้ว', 'ชื่อผู้ใช้หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง', 'กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบ', 'ยังไม่ได้เข้าร่วมโลกนี้'. Do not retype other Thai.
- Real columns only in tests. Cookies with TestClient: client.cookies is kept automatically by httpx; set cookie manually with client.cookies.set('rov_session', token) when needed.
- Never commit; never call datetime.now() in services (only in API routes); run only the test_cmd files.
